hypothesis: The official GFM-RAG Qwen3 embedding backend can reproduce the registered BIRD table/column dimension screening protocol while reducing float32 node-vector storage at lower prefix dimensions.

source.import_mode: local selective import; skip unused package-level trainer and NVEmbed imports; upstream source unchanged

stage: P1 official backend rerun, table/column only

data.gold_label_source: results/p1/full_1534_final_20261014/per_question_private.jsonl; read question id, database id, gold table/column ids and column eligibility only
data.candidate_text_definition: Table: {table_name}; columns: {all original columns}; Column: {table}.{column}; type: {BIRD type}; then non-empty database_description fields description, format, values
data.description_csv_encoding: utf-8-sig; UTF-8 decode failures fall back to cp1252; per-file encoding recorded; source files remain unchanged

model.precision: backend default from local model configuration; outputs converted to CPU float32
model.normalization: explicit L2 normalization after each prefix truncation; upstream normalize attribute is recorded but upstream embed does not apply it

evaluation.query_instruction: Given a natural-language question about a database, retrieve the relevant tables and columns.
evaluation.score: exact cosine via dot product of L2-normalized float32 prefixes
evaluation.budget_tokenization: local Qwen tokenizer; passage text only, no special tokens
